resources.name: FEniCS (or equivalent open‑source finite element solver)

access.notes: The agent may use any open‑source FE library (FEniCS, scikit‑fem, etc.) or implement a custom plane‑stress linear elasticity solver.

resources.notes: Not strictly required—the FE computation can be done with other tools or a custom implementation.

resources.name: Gmsh (mesh generation)

access.notes: Gmsh is a common mesh generator; the agent may use any mesh generator or built‑in meshing of the chosen FE solver.

resources.notes: Optional depending on the FE solver's meshing capabilities.

resources.name: Python scientific stack

access.notes: Install via pip from PyPI (or the Tsinghua mirror).

resources.notes: Required for numerical operations and output file writing.
